tagline: World's leading farmed salmon producer with integrated operations across seven countries
hero_kpi_rationale: Primary driver of growth and global leadership position in salmon aquaculture. Key physical volume metric to capture economies of scale and sustainable production trajectory.

kpis.name: Harvest Volume (GWT)
kpis.explanation: Total quantity of salmon harvested, measured in gross weight tonnes.
kpis.description: Full-year harvest volumes of 558,870 GWT in 2025, exceeding 2024 (501,530 GWT), driven by strong operational performance and improved production capacity.

kpis.name: Operational Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from farming and processing operations.
kpis.description: Operational revenue of EUR 5,729 million in 2025, up 2.0% vs 2024 (EUR 5,617 million), supported by higher volumes and operational efficiency despite lower realized prices.

kpis.name: Operational EBIT
kpis.explanation: Operating earnings before interest and taxes from core farming and processing operations.
kpis.description: Operational EBIT declined to EUR 726.8 million in 2025 from EUR 828.9 million in 2024, reflecting lower realized salmon prices despite record harvest volumes and improved operational costs.
kpis.signal: Margin compression despite record volumes due to lower realized prices

kpis.name: Operational EBIT Margin
kpis.explanation: Operational EBIT as a percentage of operational revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin compressed to 12.7% in 2025 from 14.8% in 2024 (down 2.1 percentage points), driven by lower realized salmon prices in a weaker market environment.
kpis.signal: Margin compression from 14.8% in 2024 to 12.7% in 2025

kpis.name: Cumulative Cost Savings
kpis.explanation: Accumulated annual cost savings from Mowi's multi-year efficiency and productivity program since 2018.
kpis.description: Completed 2025 cost savings program with EUR 65 million in annual savings. Cumulative savings reached EUR 392 million since program inception in 2018. New 2026 program targets EUR 30 million additional annual savings.
kpis.signal: 2025 program completed with EUR 65M annual savings, cumulative EUR 392M since 2018

kpis.name: Headcount (FTE)
kpis.explanation: Total headcount measured in full-time equivalent positions across the organization.
kpis.description: FTE count of 14,195 in 2025, down 3,489 employees on a like-for-like basis since 2020 productivity program initiation, equivalent to 44% productivity improvement. Target for 2026 is further reduction of 250 FTEs.
kpis.signal: FTE reduction of 3,489 since 2020, representing 44% productivity improvement

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of EUR 10.23 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of EUR 3.46 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Feed Partnership Savings
kpis.explanation: Expected annualized net cost savings from the strategic partnership with Skretting/Nutreco for feed production.
kpis.description: Strategic and industrial partnership with Skretting/Nutreco where Mowi Feed produces feed based on Skretting formulations. Partnership expected to deliver at least EUR 55 million in annualized net cost savings.
kpis.signal: Strategic feed partnership delivering structural cost savings through shared formulation and production

kpis.name: Biomass in Sea
kpis.explanation: Volume of farmed salmon in active production stages at sea, measured in live weight tonnes.
kpis.description: Biomass in sea reached seasonally record-high of 372,000 LWT at Q4 2025, up 8.7% year-over-year, indicating a robust production base supporting 2026 harvest guidance of 605k GWT.
kpis.signal: Seasonally record-high biomass indicating strong production pipeline for 2026

risks.title: Dependence on feed partners
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the section on the strategic partnership with Skretting/Nutreco, with strong language on future reliance on a single key supplier for feed formulation. The trend is upward as the partnership is new and central to the business model. The 'Industrial' category carries high weight in the context of an integrated value chain.

risks.title: Sea lice infestations
risks.score_rationale: The risk is recurring, with explicit mention of heavy investment in lasers and other technologies. The language is intense ("investing heavily", "improve fish welfare"). The trend is stable, but the risk remains critical for salmon health and regulation. High weight in the Industrial category.

risks.title: Escapes of farmed salmon
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in performance indicators with two incidents in 2025 (26,800 salmon). The language is measured but the risk is closely monitored (zero escape target). Trend is downward compared to 2024, but remains critical. Environmental category is heavily weighted.

risks.title: Increased global market competition
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions global overproduction of 12% in 2025, negatively impacting prices. The language is concerned ("high industry supply growth", "impacted market prices"). Trend is upward. The Competition category is central to profitability.

risks.title: Dependence on Norwegian regulation
risks.score_rationale: The risk is implicit but strong: Norway is the primary production site, and measures such as the "environmental flexibility scheme" in 2025 directly influence investments. Language is neutral but position is central. Trend is stable. The Regulation category is critical for expansion.

risks.title: Constrained technological innovation
risks.score_rationale: Mowi is heavily investing in lasers, closed pens, Mowi 4.0, but the document does not explicitly mention risks of technological failure. Language is positive but implies challenges. Trend is stable. The Technology category is moderately weighted.

risks.title: Risky international expansion
risks.score_rationale: Entry into the Middle East (UAE) and Thailand is recent. The document highlights opportunities but not specific risks. Trend is new. The Geopolitical category is moderate but growing with internationalization.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or AI-related initiatives in the disclosed documents. Mowi's strategy focuses on operational excellence, cost reduction through proven efficiency programs (Mowi 4.0 referenced), organic production growth, and strategic partnerships.
evidence: No AI or cognitive technology references in 10-K MD&A or financial statements
Focus areas: operational performance, cost management, productivity metrics, and production capacity
Absence of AI-related KPIs, investments, or strategic initiatives
